s.note: Dates stuffed with goat's cheese and almond, dried figs, cheddar and crackers
s.how: Split 12 medjool dates and fill each with goat's cheese and a toasted almond. Halve 8 dried figs. Lay out on a rough board with shards of 200g aged cheddar and crackers.

s.note: Griddled yoghurt flatbreads brushed with garlic and herb oil.
s.how: Mix 400g self-raising flour, 400g Greek yoghurt and 1 tsp salt into a soft dough, knead 2 minutes and divide into 8. Roll each to 3mm and cook in a dry hot pan for 2 minutes a side until puffed and blistered. Brush with 4 tbsp olive oil warmed with 3 crushed garlic cloves and a handful of chopped parsley, and serve warm.

m.note: Garlic and rosemary lamb leg with roast potatoes and homemade mint sauce
m.how: Stud a 2kg lamb leg with garlic and rosemary, rub with oil and salt, and roast at 180C until 58C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Mix chopped mint with sugar, 3 tbsp vinegar and boiling water for mint sauce.

w.note: Apple rings in light batter, fried hot and rolled in cinnamon sugar.
w.how: Peel and core 4 apples, slice into 1cm rings. Whisk 200g self-raising flour, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 egg and 250ml milk to a smooth batter. Dip the rings and fry in 180C oil for 2 minutes a side in batches until golden, drain on paper and roll in 4 tbsp caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Serve hot with cream.

d.note: Fresh ginger syrup, lemon and soda water, no alcohol
d.how: Grate 100g fresh ginger and simmer with 150g brown sugar and 300ml water for 10 minutes. Cool, then strain, pressing hard on the ginger. Stir in the juice of 2 lemons. Divide the syrup between 4 tall glasses of ice and top each with 200ml cold soda water. Stir and add a lime wedge and a thin slice of ginger.
